seasonRead.headline: 2008–09: Speed sets the table; playmaking makes the next play
paragraphs: Rush / Transition Chance Creator is the clearest attacking identity in this pool. Its shot and possession-continuation signals read like a role built to push pace and create before five defenders can settle into shape.

High-Volume Playmaking Scorer adds a connective layer through assists and takeaways, giving the attack another route to its next chance. Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist supplies a defensive-detail counterweight, so the forward pool separates creation from support instead of asking every player to solve the same problem.

seasonRead.headline: 2008–09: The blue line splits between surviving and advancing
paragraphs: Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman describes a block-heavy workload under sustained shot pressure. That is a role signal, not proof of better defense: the opponent has to own enough of the shift for those blocks to accumulate.

The roster-construction story is the combined presence of Offensive Puck-Moving Defenseman and Puck-Pressure Transition Defenseman. One adds production from the back end; the other links recoveries to the next play, creating natural complements for a stay-at-home partner.
